outgoing.name: Capital
outgoing.excerpt: Bamako, population 1,690,471 ( 2006), is the capital of Mali, and is the biggest city in the country.

outgoing.name: Fish
outgoing.excerpt: There is commercial fishing on the Niger River.

outgoing.name: Metal
outgoing.excerpt: Manufactures include textiles, processed meat, and metal goods.

outgoing.name: World Health Organization
outgoing.excerpt: In 1988, Bamako was the location of a WHO conference known as the Bamako Initiative that helped reshape health policy of Sub-Saharan Africa.

outgoing.name: 19th century
outgoing.excerpt: …Muslim learning under the Mali Empire, but by the 19th century it had declined.
